The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. The trial completed in 3 minutes and 30 seconds, confirming the stability of the current calculation method. Future iterations should maintain this logic while verifying that edge cases in the weighted-risk matrix do not degrade the judge_reward from its current 0.83.
